q: What is a WhatsApp AI agent?
a: A WhatsApp AI agent is an assistant built on language models that handles the conversations on your WhatsApp Business account: it understands what the customer writes, answers with your business's information, qualifies them, logs them in your CRM and can book them an appointment. Unlike a menu-based chatbot, it doesn't force people to choose from fixed options.
short: An AI assistant that runs your WhatsApp Business: it understands, answers, qualifies, logs to your CRM and books appointments.
